in_hebrew.name: Brockie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Brockie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'broc' meaning 'brook' or 'body of water'. This name was commonly given to children born near or by a brook.

in_greek.name: Brockie

in_greek.long_meaning: Brockie είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English word 'broc' meaning 'brook' or 'body of water'. This name was commonly given to children born near or by a brook.

in_latin.name: Brockie
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Little brook
